::: {#thm-mse-expand}
#### Expanded mean squared error

For any one-dimensional estimator $\hparam$ of an estimand $\param$,
the [mean squared error](#def-mse) is:

$$\mselr{\hparam} = \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-mse-expand, worked in @sol-mse-expand.

:::
